pre_backup_script.name: Export Paperless-ngx
pre_backup_script.description: Run Paperless's document exporter into its export folder, and stop the backup if the export did not finish.

notes: Before each backup, Borg UI runs Paperless's document_exporter in the container. The export holds your documents, tags, correspondents and settings, so the database works the same with SQLite, PostgreSQL or MariaDB.
The exporter deletes files in the export folder that no longer belong to the export. Use the folder only for this.

Restore with document_importer into the same Paperless version. API tokens are not exported, and mail account passwords are exported in plain text (the Borg repository encrypts them if encryption is on).
If Borg UI talks to Docker through a socket proxy, it needs exec allowed.
